note: The spec is normative. Where a vector and spec/ disagree, the spec wins and the vector is wrong (spec/11-conformance.md section 7).
invariant: compare() is a total order: antisymmetric, transitive, and total over every ordered value. The matrix below is sign(compare(i,j)) for every pair, which is well defined where a sort permutation is not - section 8 makes many of these values EQUAL, and equal elements have no defined relative position in an unstable sort.
